title: SREV-017 breakout command-line argument shape

createprocess_shape.description: CreateProcessW lpCommandLine is mutable Unicode up to 32,767 characters including terminator; argv splitting (CommandLineToArgvW, MSVC CRT) does not bound individual argument length

scratch_buffer_shape.description: SbieDll_GetHandlePath uses an 8192-WCHAR path output buffer; the breakout argument adaptation reuses this 8192-WCHAR scratch buffer for drive-qualified arguments

drive_qualified_gate.description: Only drive-qualified arguments whose unquoted payload satisfies tmp_len >= 2 and tmp_len < 8192 are eligible for path remapping

copy_shape.description: Copy uses wmemcpy(temp, tmp, tmp_len) followed by temp[tmp_len] = L'\0'; no raw wcscpy(temp, tmp) remains in the breakout path

fallback_shape.description: Oversized or malformed parsed arguments are preserved in the rebuilt command line without remapping; scratch allocation failure preserves the original argument tail

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate: overlong quoted drive-path argument preserved without overflow; ordinary breakout path remapping still works

contracts: Quoted-argument branch computes tmp_len = (len >= 2) ? len - 2 : 0; never underflows
Drive-qualified check requires tmp_len >= 2 and the first two WCHARs match a drive letter + colon
Copy into scratch is bounded by tmp_len < 8192
Terminator is written at temp[tmp_len], not at temp[len-2]
No raw wcscpy(temp, tmp) remains in the breakout argument adaptation path
Existing local parser and service validation boundary are unchanged; breakout policy is unchanged
